reviews.author: Gen Taylor
reviews.text:
We had such a great experience with 360 Garage Door and More. Jenny answered the phone and was incredibly friendly, kind, and helpful. They were able to get us scheduled very quickly, which we really appreciated.

Will came out to repair our garage door spring and install a new keypad. He was quick, friendly, professional, and did a great job. The whole process was easy, fast, and very affordable.

We are extremely happy with the service we received and would absolutely recommend 360 Garage Door and More to anyone needing garage door repair or service.

reviews.author: Cameron Spitzer
reviews.text: Great Company.  They replaced my doors and openers with quality materials at a lower cost than the competitors.  Then,  they came back a couple months later just to check and make sure everything was working as it is supposed to.  Highly recommend.

reviews.text: Great people!

reviews.text: Excellent and fast customer service! He stayed and helped me set up the app and everything

reviews.author: Diana Viviano
reviews.text: Very professional, courteous, friendly (love Jenny) phone skills and texting on availability was superb. Will was amazing and skillful in his service repair. All in all, we had a truly great experience with 360 garage door repair service and they were the most reasonable price around after comparing service calls with several companies. Great job 360!! We will be using you in the future and referring you to others in need of garage door services. A+

reviews.author: Brandon Inman
reviews.text: Can't say thank you enough times! I called with a garage door that would not open and was in horrible shape! I asked for an estimate on a motorized system. They showed up the same day and by the time they left i had a garage door you could open with one hand and the best part a belt driven system installed that is quiet. They were super nice people and communicated very well with us through the entire process. I would recommend them 100 times over. Thank you!

reviews.author: Christine Kallmbah
reviews.text: Inquired on FB for recommendations regarding a garage door. Over half the comments referred them! I can see why. A pleasure to do business with! Husband/wife team. Jenny is a doll, a big help with choosing a garage door you want and very budget friendly! Will installs them. He’s just as friendly and did an amazing job! If I could give them 10 stars I would! Choose them for your garage door needs. I promise you will not regret it! I wanted to post a picture of my door but it won’t let me.

reviews.author: Shirley LaMar
reviews.text: Never hesitate to call this company! They were responsive and professional. Will came out after we had an animal incident in our garage. He got to work immediately and repairs were done in about 45 minutes. Both doors function smoothly and the wiring is now as it should have been at the original installation! A pleasant and efficient company to do business with! CALL!

reviews.author: Aaron Yuan
reviews.text: Good service, even come when you need help at holiday!

reviews.author: Matthew Smith
reviews.text: Excellent pricing, professional installation. All around a great company. Very friendly staff and easy to work with. From start to finish it was flawless. We are painting the door and the technician left the trim loose for the perfect application for paint.

reviews.author: Jordan Law
reviews.text: Top notch! Quick response, helpful, great communication, and the garage door experts!  Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Dave Puckett
reviews.text:
I hired 360 Garage Door and More to replace our 20+ year old chain driven garage door openers and to replace some equally old coils that were on their last legs. They paid attention to every detail and even serviced the tracks and rollers to ensure everything worked correctly. Pricing was reasonable, communication was great, and the finished product was outstanding. My wife LOVES how quiet the new openers are and that she can now open the doors from her car and an app on her phone.

I definitely recommend this company for both repairs and new projects!

reviews.author: Scott Sturm
reviews.text: Easy to see why they have a perfect 5 star review, Will and the team here are AWESOME! Super punctual service, expert workmanship, and excellent pricing. Highly satisfied customer and they're my go to garage door business from now on!

reviews.author: jason tourville
reviews.text: I am very happy with the job Will did on our garage door spring replacement. My door works better now than ever.

reviews.author: Marcie Spitzer
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company! We got our new garage doors installed yesterday and they look amazing!  Very professional and the gentleman that did the installation was very polite and kept things picked up while he worked. We are very happy with the quality and service.

reviews.author: Connie Jackson
reviews.text: We had Will from 360 Garage Door come do a routine maintenance on our garage door. He spotted a couple of areas that would considerably improve our door efficiency.  He explained what he recommended gave us pricing and had the materials on hand.  He completed everything quickly and efficiently!  Highly recommend this company and we will be using them for any future needs!

reviews.author: Gregory Ritchie
reviews.text: We had a garage door emergency on Easter Sunday - I saw 360 had solid reviews on a Facebook group I am in, so I reached out via messenger.  Jenny replied on Easter!  That was the first example of outstanding service that I did not expect them to do...Will came out the very next day (again, beyond my expectations), and we had a brand new garage door, for way less than I had guessed, by Thursday at lunchtime!  This is the kind of experience that can be hard to come by nowadays unfortunately....but Will and Jenny went above and beyond, and renewed my faith that there are still great companies out there doing honest work!  My mom is on the schedule to get her new garage door now too!  If you need garage service, do yourself a favor and call 360, you will not regret it!

reviews.author: Paul Choate
reviews.text: Great company

reviews.author: Shelby Linton
reviews.text: Great customer service and communication! I will always do work with them!

reviews.author: Carla Parris
reviews.text: Thank you. So happy with my door. And the service. They were very prompt and efficient.  Jenny was very knowledgeable and helpful. Thank you again.  Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Ryan Rommel
reviews.text: Had 360 out to replace a broken spring (installed only 5 years ago by a different company..). They noticed that the springs I had were undersized and recommended I replace with a larger one after weighing door and calculating the proper size. Great price, got scheduled and repaired within a day. Great people and service, reasonable price, definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Chris Keaton
reviews.text: Will did a fantastic job on our old huge garage door that was sagging from age. He thoroughly explained the problem and the best solution along with a great estimate, the work was completed quickly. I highly recommend 360 Garage Door and More for anyone needing quality repair or replacement work!

reviews.author: Scott Wellever
reviews.text: These guys are amazing - they do all of our family's homes!

reviews.author: Brent Gilstrap
reviews.text: 360 has fixed and serviced my garage doors. Great communication and speedy, knowledgeable service. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jon Wersinger
reviews.text: I needed 2 springs replaced on a 2 car garage door.Jenny was honest and open about pricing and when they could install the new springs. Will and Blake did the install and were great to work with. We discussed what type of maintenance a homeowner can do. They do quality work and their pricing was the best in Springfield. I would highly recommend 360 Garage Door & More!!

reviews.author: Julie Lohmeyer
reviews.text: It's been a long time since we have had such a great experience when we need someone to fix something that was broken.  Prompt call back and the same with their service. Definitely will use 360 door works again! Highly recommend 👌

reviews.author: Judi Wills
reviews.text: Excellent company to do business with.  Scheduled me in right away, showed up on time, very knowledgeable and explained everything in detail.  They gave me options and let me choose what I wanted done, what had to be repaired now and what could wait.  I chose to do everything at once, which made my price higher, but still significantly less than what I thought it would cost and I wasn't pressured to do any of it. They didn't do anything without letting me know and were completely transparent in their work.

reviews.author: Bethny Bain
reviews.text: Will and Jenny are the best.  Honest, trustworthy and punctual.  Excellent work.  Will be using them in the future if need be.  Thank you both. Second time using, so prompt and quick.  Just the Best.

reviews.author: Gavin
reviews.text: Same day service and got my door fixed

reviews.author: Debbie Christopher
reviews.text: 360 Garage Door and More were recommended to us by a realtor friend. Great recommendation with great service. Quick, on time, friendly, knowledgeable, very reasonable…and they didn’t try to sell us additional services. Happy to have our door open and close consistently and have our outdoor pad updated. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Kolby Harris
reviews.text: Great people, good service, and very professional. My only choice for garage door service/repair.

reviews.author: Steve Brooks
reviews.text: Showed exceptional care to make sure my garage doors were working correctly, after some issues that came up a year or so after they provided fixes.

reviews.author: Mike Fullinton
reviews.text: Amazing company that comes on time. Very friendly staff and knowledgeable on their work. Also lower prices than others and great service. I’d recommend to others needing garage door repair

reviews.author: Kelsie Bates
reviews.text: Our garage door service and repair was done by Will and it was a really great experience! He was very knowledgeable, considerate and professional. His recommendations were mindful to ensure that our garage was not only working properly, but that it was stabilized and safe. Will had everything he needed to complete our repair on his truck, so it was quick and efficient. We were recommended this company by others and I would definitely recommend for garage door service or repair.

reviews.author: Kathy Davis
reviews.text: I had the BEST experience with 360 garage doors! I was so discouraged when my garage door quit working with my car trapped inside on Sunday. I texted 360 and Will was here Monday morning at 10 and had it fixed by 11:30 for a fair price. He was polite, knowledgeable, and easy to communicate with. Legendary service!

reviews.author: Arnold Shreffler
reviews.text: 360 Garage Doors and More in Springfield, MO is a terrific service provider. I messaged them on the weekend after my g-door's return spring broke. I was contacted within hours to set up a repair appointment on Monday morning and they even offered to get things out of the garage prior to the repair if we needed help. The repairman arrived right on time and completed the repair very quickly. He was courteous and proficient. The repaired door worked better than it did when it was first installed. 360 Garage Doors and More are THE VERY BEST. A big "Thank You" to Will and Jenny.

reviews.author: Scott Heffern
reviews.text: My project was replacing a 1980 7ft overhead door with a 9’-6” tall door for my reframed opening so we could fit our new camper van. Will and Jenny were great with fair pricing and lighting quick installation. The came out in person to coordinate the door size my reframing. Will had the door installed in a few hours and cleaned workspace. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Tony s
reviews.text: We scheduled a service call to check on our garage door, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience! They showed up fast, were incredibly friendly, and had our door working in no time. They know their stuff and truly care about great service. We’re so glad we chose them and will absolutely be calling again for any future garage door needs. Highly recommend

reviews.author: John Oliver
reviews.text: Cant say enough good things about these folks. Communication is top notch, garage door opener was installed quickly and perfectly. If you have any garage door needs, the buck stops here!

reviews.author: M H
reviews.text: “I had a great experience with 360 Garage Door! The team was professional, efficient, and got the job done quickly. They provided excellent service, and my garage door works perfectly. Highly recommend!”

reviews.author: Shanna McMaster
reviews.text: Will had my garage door opener springs replaced in no time, and was at my house within an hour of my call. Excellent service!

reviews.author: Jeremy Brookman
reviews.text: Speedy Same Day Service. Called Jenny, this moring and set the appointment for this moring. Will showed up ahead of time and replaced my broken spring and a few brackets. He was done within 30 Minutes. Highly recommend 360 Garage Door & More.

reviews.author: Stephen Graff
reviews.text: Will replace our garage door and opener at our previous home 3 years ago, so when we needed service for our new home I did not hesitate to call.  He came out and replaced the bottom seal on the door plus fixed a couple of items to prevent bigger issues in the future.  The door is operating perfectly and the charges were extremely fair!  Highly recommend doing business with Will and Jenny!

reviews.author: Kathy McCrary
reviews.text:
I called 360 Garage Door and Will was at our house very quickly. He did necessary repairs and serviced the doors. Great service by extremely nice people...... I also LOVE that they're a local Springfield business ..... not a chain. I'll be using them for any future services.

THANK YOU 360!!!!

reviews.author: DG
reviews.text: Will and Jenny provided excellent service! From the diagnostics and repair with Will to the customer service/follow up and warmth from Jenny, everything exceeded our expectations. Thank y'all so very much!

reviews.author: Meiling Cheng
reviews.text: I tried to replace the keypad on my Chamberlain garage door opener and I could not figure it out.  I had used Will at 360 Garage Door & More several years ago to put in 2 new garage door openers so I gave Will a call.  Will came out the next available appointment time that he had and replace and programmed the remote like I asked him to and while he was there he lubricated both of my doors and adjusted them.

reviews.author: MO Country Life
reviews.text: Very honest people to deal with. Had two openers put in  today. Work was neat and clean. What they tell you is exactly what they do.
